name: persona-lane
title: Persona lane
description: One lane of a run: the keyframe a persona saw, its verbatim final report, and an honest status chip — failed lanes render muted, never hidden. Ships the resolve-cover canvas veil that dissolves into the screenshot (finished state under reduced motion).
docs: Import styles once in your global CSS: @import "../styles/humanish/persona-lane.css";. Example: <PersonaLane idx="01" name="sticky-notes" img="/lane.jpg" alt="…" reportLabel="Final report — verbatim" report="Done." passed />
